title: 7. How remiſſion of ſinnes is giuen.

segments.text:
REmiſſion of ſins is giuen by faith,
by which being wrought and kindled in vs by the holy Ghoſt, wee receiue the ſame. Therefore the purpoſe and decree of God, of remitting ſinnes, is euerlaſting; but the executing and performance thereof is, when by faith we applie remiſſion of ſins vnto vs. So alſo God doth alwaies loue his elect, but that loue is not poured out in their hearts before their repentance. For they haue that certain teſtimonie of conſciēce by the gift of the holy Ghoſt, that they are loued of god & ſo haue their ſins remitted, who truly conuert and repent.
